name: Shipment Date Range
definition: Specifies a shipment period or a shipment date.

LatestShipmentDate.name: Latest Shipment Date
LatestShipmentDate.definition: Latest date whereby the goods must be shipped.

EarliestShipmentDate.name: Earliest Shipment Date
EarliestShipmentDate.definition: Earliest date whereby the items must be shipped.

ShipmentDate.name: Shipment Date
ShipmentDate.definition: Date at which the goods are shipped.

RelatedTransport.name: Related Transport
RelatedTransport.definition: Specifies the transport process to which the dates apply.
